 We did not upload the real scan data here, because of the privacy protection for NOMO custormers, please contact the authors to access the dataset. BUT we uploaded the fits of the scans : caesar6449v_nicp_fits.zip : fits of the CAESAR mean body shape, 6449 vertices, using NICP, the same topology as "Building statistical shape spaces for 3d human modeling" smpl6890v_nicp_fits.zip : fits of the SMPL template, 6890 vertices, using NICP smpl6890v_lbfgsb_fits.zip : fits of the SMPL template, 6890 vertices, using LBFGSB algorithm rendered_rgb.zip : rendered RGB images with SMPL fits, using SURREAL algorithm, with random RGB background images, random noisy background images, and silhouettes. smpl_lbfgsb_params.zip : parameters of SMPL LBFGSB fits, can be used for initial meshes for NICP bodymeasurement_mat.zip : body measurements from a tailor, the tailor did the measurement on the customer body, so there may be differences between scans and real body. For body measurements, if needed, you can define the measurement paths by yourself. The scans are collected by NOMO Technologies (https://nomo3d.com/) Ltd, Finland. We scanned 1474 male and 2675 female 3D body scans (BODY-fit), and captured a realistic RGB dataset (BODY-rgb) of 86 male and 108 female subjects and manually tape measured ground truth. This database is only used for scientific purpose.
